Use [{+frag}] + [{+smoke}] to trigger your charged field upgrade and kill 5 zombies
Use essence to refill ammo at the Ammo Cache
Essence is gained from killing zombies
Different types of kills award different amounts of essence
Pick up salvage from the ground

Use salvage to purchase a Frag at a Crafting Table

Buy Melee Macchiato from the machine
Perk-a-Colas can be bought at unique machines - or from Der Wunderfizz, accessible later in the game
Use [{+melee}] to kill 3 zombies with Melee Macchiato
Perk-a-Colas have a variety of effects - some passive, and some active
With armor, you take reduced damage from attacks
Take enough damage from the zombies to break a plate
You must have armor in your reserves to plate up
Purchase a Level II Armor Vest at the Wall Buy

ZM_TRAINING_COURSE/ZOMBIE_STATION_4_STEP: Use the Pack-A-Punch to upgrade your weapon
The Pack-a-Punch takes essence to increase weapon damage and ammo capacity
Kill an armored zombie with the packed weapon
Use the Arsenal to upgrade your weapon's rarity to ^2uncommon^7
The Arsenal has tabs for Ammo Mods and Weapon Rarity
The Arsenal takes salvage to equip Ammo Mods and increase Weapon Rarity
Kill an armored zombie with the upgraded weapon
Weapons of higher rarity deal more damage
Use the Arsenal to give your weapon the Brain Rot Ammo Mod
Trigger Brain Rot on a zombie and turn it friendly
Not every shot will trigger the Ammo Mod's effect - but keep shooting and it'll come!
ZM_TRAINING_COURSE/ZOMBIE_STATION_4_TITL: Increase your lethality with weapon upgrades

At a Wall Buy, you can spend essence to purchase weapons
As rounds advance, the rarity of Wall Buy weapons will increase
Wall Buys of higher rarity will come with more weapon attachments
The Mystery Box will appear in a random spot around the map
At the Mystery Box, you can spend essence to purchase random weapons and scorestreaks
The Mystery Box tends to vanish and reappear on the map after a few uses
The Ray Gun is a Wonder Weapon that you can pull from the box with a little luck
Use the Ray Gun to kill 3 zombies

Select one with [{ui_button_dpad_vertical}], and use it with [{+gostand}]
You can hold up to 3 GobbleGums at a time
Purchase another GobbleGum from the machine
You have a limited amount of time to grab the GobbleGum once it appears
Take the GobbleGums from the machine
